Answer: C
Reason: The ultrasound images show cystic lesions in the fetal thorax (indicated by arrows) without evidence of significant mass effect; specifically, there is no mediastinal shift or diaphragmatic inversion, which aligns with a lower lobe location adjacent to the heart with an intact diaphragm. Options describing displacement of the heart or diaphragm are inconsistent with the lack of compressive signs visible in the scans.
